source: But KV-cache quantization is numerically different from weight quantization. Keys and values are generated dynamically from each request. Their distributions can vary by layer, head, token, and model architecture. Quantization error also feeds future attention calculations for every subsequent decode step.
zh: 但 KV 缓存量化在数值上与权重量化不同。键和值是根据每个请求动态生成的。它们的分布可能因层、头、令牌和模型架构而异​​。量化误差还为每个后续解码步骤提供未来的注意力计算。
